title: Lace Bodysuit in Velvet
reference_source: Серия в кружевном белье — гламурный будуарный регистр
mood_ru: Бархатный будуар, свечи, шёлковый халат сползает с плеч. Самый тёплый и мягкий сет.
allure: lace lingerie editorial glamour, delicate lace set with full opaque lining, sculpted waist and long legs, soft boudoir light gliding over the lace, assured sensual gaze, sheer-panelled lace bodysuit under a silk robe sliding off both shoulders

wardrobe.notes_ru: Кружевное боди с подкладкой + шёлковый халат, сползающий с плеч.
wardrobe.prompt: black lace bodysuit with full opaque lining and delicate lace panels, deep plunging neckline, champagne silk robe worn open and sliding off both shoulders, silver star pendant, hair loose and tousled, bare feet

location.notes_ru: Тёмный бархатный будуар, свечи, тяжёлые ткани, старое зеркало.
location.prompt: dark boudoir room, deep burgundy velvet sofa, dozens of lit candles, heavy draped fabrics, antique gilt mirror, low brass table, worn parquet floor, warm shadowed corners

shots.pose: standing in the candlelit room letting the silk robe slide down off both shoulders to her elbows, revealing the lace bodysuit, chin lifted, steady sensual eye contact
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, frontal, thigh-up framing
shots.light: clustered candles low and close, warm falloff into the dark velvet behind her

shots.pose: lying back along the velvet sofa propped on one elbow, robe open and spilling to the floor, one knee raised, the other leg stretched long, languid look down the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at sofa level, three-quarter front angle, full body framing
shots.light: candle key from the floor, deep warm shadows folding into the velvet

shots.pose: kneeling back on her heels on the burgundy velvet sofa, spine deeply arched, one hand planted beside her, head turned over the shoulder holding direct eye contact with the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, slightly above eye level, back three-quarter angle, full body vertical framing
shots.light: clustered candlelight close and low on her skin, one warm shaft of light through the drapes along her shoulder

shots.pose: standing close to the antique gilt mirror, one hand resting on the surface, hip pushed out, chin lowered, holding her own gaze while the camera catches her and the reflection at once
shots.camera: 50mm lens, eye level, over-the-shoulder into the reflection, thigh-up framing
shots.light: clustered candlelight close and low on her skin, one warm shaft of light through the drapes along her shoulder

shots.pose: standing at the heavily draped window with one shaft of light with one forearm raised against the frame, weight settled on one hip, back to the camera, long line of the spine on show, looking away into the light
shots.camera: 35mm lens, eye level, back view, full body vertical framing
shots.light: clustered candlelight close and low on her skin, one warm shaft of light through the drapes along her shoulder

shots.pose: reclining back on the burgundy velvet sofa propped on both elbows, one knee raised and the other leg stretched long, ribcage lifted, chin up, half-lidded gaze straight down the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, low camera at surface level, three-quarter front angle, full body framing
shots.light: clustered candlelight close and low on her skin, one warm shaft of light through the drapes along her shoulder

shots.pose: cropped detail composition of the lace panel over her ribs and the silk pooling at her elbow, face out of frame, fingers relaxed and naturally posed
shots.camera: 85mm lens, close detail framing, very shallow depth of field
shots.light: clustered candlelight close and low on her skin, one warm shaft of light through the drapes along her shoulder

shots.pose: lying on her back on the burgundy velvet sofa, one arm thrown above her head, the other hand resting on her waist, hair fanned out, knees softly bent, eyes lifted to the lens
shots.camera: 35mm lens, directly overhead top-down angle, full body framing
shots.light: clustered candlelight close and low on her skin, one warm shaft of light through the drapes along her shoulder

shots.pose: standing tall among the candles in the middle of the room, one hand pushing back through her hair with the elbow raised, weight shifted onto one leg so the hip breaks the line, chin down and eyes up into the lens
shots.camera: 50mm lens, slightly low angle, frontal, full body framing
shots.light: clustered candlelight close and low on her skin, one warm shaft of light through the drapes along her shoulder

shots.pose: seen small across the space across the candlelit velvet room, caught mid-movement and not looking at the camera, the room itself carrying the mood
shots.camera: 24mm wide lens, eye level, wide environmental full-body shot
shots.light: clustered candlelight close and low on her skin, one warm shaft of light through the drapes along her shoulder

film: shot on Kodak Portra 800 pushed one stop, candle halation, coarse warm grain
